title: Jonah 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: Jonah, sent to Nineveh, flees to Tarshish.
He is stayed by a tempest.
He is cast into the sea, and miraculously preserved.

outline.text: Jonah, sent to Nineveh, flees to Tarshish.

context: Jonah was a native of Galilee, 2Ki 14:25.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.

title: Jonah 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: Jonah sent again to Nineveh, preaches there.
Nineveh is spared upon the repentance of the inhabitants.

title: Jonah 4: chapter overview
paragraphs: Jonah repines at God's mercy to Nineveh, and is reproved.
He is taught by the withering of a gourd, that he did wrong.
